name: ResponsivePanels
description: Display grouped panels of content as an Accordion or Tabs depending on available space. Uses Vue to determine which to show and only renders the HTML for the current view.

breakpoint.description: The container breakpoint at which to switch between accordion and tabs

colorTheme.description: Colour keyword for theming purposes. May be used for headings, buttons, accents, and other UI elements according to the component implementation.

context.description: The kebab-case or BEM element chain name of the parent component or variant (if contextually relevant).

isNested.description: Whether this component is nested inside another element; used for simplifying layout and HTML structure handling

orientation.description: Orientation of the component content, if applicable

shortName.description: The name of the component without any namespacing, prefixes, etc. Used for BEM block/element naming. Derived from the Blade filename if not explicitly set.

size.description: Keyword specifying the relative width of the container for the inner content if the component is not nested inside another layout component. Ignored if the component has an isNested attribute set to true, or other logic determines that it is not nested.

tagName.description: The HTML tag to use for this component

testId.description: Optionally add a data-testid attribute for automated tests

innerComponents.description: Inner components to be rendered within this component
